mapper.select: SELECT model_name AS modelName, duration_ms AS durationMs FROM t_agent_trace WHERE start_time >= #{since} AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL

SELECT id, request_id AS requestId, model_name AS modelName, duration_ms AS durationMs, endpoint, start_time AS startTime FROM t_agent_trace WHERE start_time >= #{since} AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY duration_ms DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS traceTotal, AVG(grounding_rate) AS groundingAvg, AVG(retention_rate) AS retentionAvg, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DEGRADED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS degraded, SUM(CASE WHEN token_total IS NOT NULL AND token_total > 0 THEN token_total ELSE 0 END) AS tokensTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN call_path LIKE '%focus=DETOUR%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS focusDetour, SUM(CASE WHEN call_path LIKE '%focus=DETOUR%' THEN 0 WHEN call_path LIKE '%focus=MAINLINE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS focusMainline, SUM(CASE WHEN call_path LIKE '%detourSkip=true%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detourIsolated FROM t_agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since}

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN token_total IS NOT NULL AND token_total > 0 THEN token_total ELSE 0 END) AS tokens, COUNT(*) AS traces FROM t_agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
SELECT model_name AS modelName, status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY model_name, status

SELECT grounding_rate AS val, rn, cnt FROM ( SELECT grounding_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY grounding_rate) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM t_agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since} AND grounding_rate IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE rn = ROUND(0.25 * (cnt - 1)) + 1 OR rn = ROUND(0.75 * (cnt - 1)) + 1
SELECT model_name AS modelName, duration_ms AS durationMs FROM t_agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since} AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms >= 0
